mapper.sql: c.publication_status = 'PUBLISHED' and c.visibility = 'PUBLIC' and c.admission_status = 'PASSED' and c.is_duplicate = false and c.fact_status <> 'DEBUNKED'

c.id, s.name as source_name, c.source_type, c.source_official_level, c.content_type, coalesce(c.title_zh, c.original_title) as title, c.original_title, c.summary_zh as summary, c.recommendation_reason, c.original_url, c.canonical_url, c.fact_status, c.final_score, c.featured, c.source_published_at, c.published_at
mapper.select: select t.id, t.slug, t.group_code, t.name, t.description, t.query_text, count(distinct c.id) as content_count, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.featured) as featured_count, t.updated_at from content.topic t left join content.content_item c on and c.search_tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', replace(t.query_text, ' ', ' OR ')) where t.status = 'ACTIVE' group by t.id order by t.group_code, t.sort_order, t.id

select t.id, t.slug, t.group_code, t.name, t.description, t.query_text, count(distinct c.id) as content_count, count(distinct c.id) filter (where c.featured) as featured_count, t.updated_at from content.topic t left join content.content_item c on and c.search_tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', replace(t.query_text, ' ', ' OR ')) where t.status = 'ACTIVE' and t.slug = #{slug} group by t.id

select from content.content_item c join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where and c.search_tsv @@ websearch_to_tsquery('simple', replace(#{queryText}, ' ', ' OR ')) order by c.featured desc, c.final_score desc nulls last, c.published_at desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}

select e.id, e.title, e.summary, e.category_code, e.fact_status, count(distinct c.id) as content_count, count(distinct c.source_entity_id) as source_count, (count(distinct c.source_entity_id) * 12 + coalesce(max(c.final_score), 0) / 5 + greatest(0, 72 - extract(epoch from (now() - e.last_seen_at)) / 3600))::numeric(8,2) as heat_score, e.first_seen_at, e.last_seen_at from content.event_cluster e join content.content_event_relation r on r.event_cluster_id = e.id join content.content_item c on c.id = r.content_item_id and where e.status = 'ACTIVE' and e.fact_status <> 'DEBUNKED' and length(trim(e.title)) >= 12 group by e.id having max(c.final_score) >= 70 order by heat_score desc, e.last_seen_at desc, e.id desc limit #{limit}

select e.id, e.title, e.summary, e.category_code, e.fact_status, count(distinct c.id) as content_count, count(distinct c.source_entity_id) as source_count, (count(distinct c.source_entity_id) * 12 + greatest(0, 72 - extract(epoch from (now() - e.last_seen_at)) / 3600))::numeric(8,2) as heat_score, e.first_seen_at, e.last_seen_at from content.event_cluster e join content.content_event_relation r on r.event_cluster_id = e.id join content.content_item c on c.id = r.content_item_id and where e.id = #{id} and e.status = 'ACTIVE' and e.fact_status <> 'DEBUNKED' group by e.id

select from content.content_event_relation r join content.content_item c on c.id = r.content_item_id join source.source_entity s on s.id = c.source_entity_id where r.event_cluster_id = #{id} and order by r.is_primary desc, c.source_official_level in ('OFFICIAL','FIRST_PARTY') desc, c.published_at desc, c.id desc limit #{limit}
